description: Données trafic du réseau de la DIRMED is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Madada. Census data of daily traffic on the road network of the DIR provided by the prefecture of Provence Alpes Côte d’Azur for the years 2007 to 2018. Coverage: Madada. The portal shows the English title as "DIRMED network traffic data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Madada. Its keywords include trafic-routier, comptage-routier. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2020-03-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
